semantics: Single line n m k, each 1..2000. Count strings of length exactly n over an m-letter alphabet whose every length-k substring is a palindrome, modulo 1000000007. No length-k substring exists when k>n, so every string counts (m^n); k=1 also gives m^n; k=n forces one palindrome (m^ceil(n/2)); 1<k<n forces period-2 equality for odd k (m^2) and a constant string for even k (m). The count is unique; small domains are checked by literal enumeration of all m^n strings and by an independent position-union component count.
